lead: Glass terrarium measuring 40x40x40 cm. Volume: 64.0 liters, horizontal format. Handmade in Novi Sad.

description.html: This 40x40x40 cm glass terrarium with a volume of 64 liters is made from glass of the right thickness for its size. The outer sides are covered with decorative film you choose when ordering: wood, bamboo, marble, black or white.

The horizontal layout with 40 cm of length gives a floor area where a basking zone, a cool zone and a hiding area are easy to arrange. Proper thermoregulation depends on this layout: the animal moves between the warmer and cooler zones as needed. The ventilation openings are placed to create natural airflow from bottom to top, which maintains optimal humidity.

You can order this model with a custom film and background. If you need different dimensions or extra equipment (LED lighting, a thermostat, a lock), we build to your specification. Delivery to your address anywhere in Serbia.
